description: Existing kitchen, 13 Nov 2026: the corner and the sink wall with the wall cabinets open; microwave, espresso machine and the sink with dishes

extractions.what: Corner and sink wall: about 12 large and 14 small spice jars, tins, bags, Worcestershire; mason jars, 8 mugs, about 10 pint glasses; the snack cabinet (see 151942). Counter: microwave, DeLonghi espresso machine, bananas, agave syrup, paper towels, soap pump; in the sink a saucepan, bowls and plates; a lunch bag, a bag of rice or oats, shopping bags, a Halloween candy bucket
